verdict.rationale: OpenAI keeps a standing deprecations page that lists dated shutdowns with a recommended replacement for each model, and the changelog points developers to it for upcoming deprecations. A dedicated migration guide (Chat Completions to Responses) shows that structured migration guidance exists, though it covers an API change rather than a model retirement. Missing for 10: an explicit stated minimum advance-notice period or formal policy commitment, detailed per-model migration guides beyond naming a replacement, and independent or hands-on corroboration of notice being given in practice.
